shortDescription: Module for setup of VsVip Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: bgp_local_preference
options.description: Local_pref to be used for vsvip advertised. Applicable only over ibgp. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: bgp_num_as_path_prepend
options.description: Number of times the local as should be prepended additionally to vsvip. Applicable only over ebgp. Allowed values are 1-10. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: bgp_peer_labels
options.description: Select bgp peers, using peer label, for vsvip advertisement. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Maximum of 128 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: cloud_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type cloud. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: dns_info
options.description: Service discovery specific data including fully qualified domain name, type and time-to-live of the dns record. This takes effect only if dns profile isassociated with cloud. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Maximum of 1000 items allowed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: east_west_placement
options.description: Force placement on all service engines in the service engine group (container clouds only). Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: ipam_selector
options.description: Determines the set of ipam networks to use for this vsvip. Selector type must be selector_ipam and only one label is supported. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: markers
options.description: List of labels to be used for granular rbac. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the vsvip object. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tier1_lr
options.description: This sets the placement scope of virtualservice to given tier1 logical router in nsx-t. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the vsvip object. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vip
options.description: List of virtual service ips and other shareable entities. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vrf_context_ref
options.description: Virtual routing context that the virtual service is bound to. This is used to provide the isolation of the set of networks the application is attached to. It is a reference to an object of type vrfcontext. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: vsvip_cloud_config_cksum
options.description: Checksum of cloud configuration for vsvip. Internally set by cloud connector. Field introduced in 17.2.9, 18.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
